bullets.bullet_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs, structuring traceable scenarios and model-risk remediation evidence to support regulatory governance for large financial institutions.
Directed quantitative derivatives and insurance-capital modernization, applying exotic pricing, liability Greek hedging, and stress-testing frameworks to strengthen capital adequacy analytics.
Architected enterprise risk-governance operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability and auditable risk-data metrics across business units.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
